name: devspaces-portal-web
description: Static assets for the devspaces portal. The Go server embeds web/; only the Tailwind build needs Node.

scripts.gen:catalog: node -e "const c=require('./catalog.default.json');require('fs').writeFileSync('web/catalog.js','/* generated from deploy/platform/catalog.json by build.sh — used only by demo.js when no API is reachable */\nwindow.DEMO_CATALOG = '+JSON.stringify(c,null,1)+';\n')"
